title: ci(polyfills): enfore no unwanted polyfills are used
body:

**Summary**

<!--

We want to avoid polyfills to be needed for eg. Array.find, since it's not supported on IE11 and avoid issues like https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4580

**Result**

<!--
  Demonstrate the code is solid.
  Example: The exact commands you ran and their output,
  screenshots / videos if the pull request changes UI.

  You will be able to test out these changes on the deploy
  preview (address will be commented by a bot):

  1. the documentation site (/)

adds a new babel plugin for umd compilation only which is normally meant for injecting polyfills, but we use to error when a polyfill would be needed

In theory we could write our own polyfill provider ([docs](https://github.com/babel/babel-polyfills/blob/main/docs/polyfill-provider.md)), but that seems more complicated that using the existing es-shims one.

Thanks @ljharb for helping me out on the babel slack with understanding this!
